integrity: Proof of full formula is included, with direct small-case computational verification. Numerical checks do not establish the infinite theorem; its proof uses graded Jordan decomposition and finite centralizer orbit-stabilizer.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers only; nilpotent N fixed; signed Jordan forms known as structural input; no independent audit; possible prior equivalent signed-orbit formulas not ruled out exhaustively.
title: Signed-Jordan orbit counts for involutions anticommuting with nilpotent matrices
